data.name: Amendment a
data.summary: For consistency with prior mirikizumab studies, the inclusion criteria [12b] is updated with the following maximum baseline liver enzyme levels: alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤2 x ULN, alkaline phosphatase (ALP) ≤1.5 x ULN, and total bilirubin level (TBL) ≤1.5 x ULN. To specify that any participant who experiences serious or severe GI AEs that are consistent with worsening of UC and do not improve with the recommendations for management of intolerable GI symptoms related to tirzepatide will be evaluated for UC disease worsening. To clarify that every symptom_directed examination will also include an examination of the heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin, consistent with the existing text in the schedule of activities under "Complete Physical Examination." To add acute kidney injury as an AESI to the protocol. To include pregnancy testing every 4 weeks. This can include home urine pregnancy testing. To update that follow_up information for pregnancy outcomes for participant and neonate will be collected until termination of the pregnancy or for at least 12 months post_delivery.

data.label: Chest CT
data.description: Chest computed tomography scan used as an alternative to chest x_ray for TB evaluation within the same time window

data.name: Dual_Energy X_Ray Absorptiometry Scan

code.decode: Dual_energy X_ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study

data.label: DXA Scan
data.description: Whole body DXA scan for exploratory body composition assessment. Participants must fast for at least 8 hours (no water within 2 hours) before each scan.

data.name: Complete Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Physical Exam
data.description: Complete physical examination including heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. Excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Symptom_Directed Physical Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Directed Physical Exam
data.description: Symptom_directed physical evaluation including examination of heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. Performed at each clinic visit based on participant status.

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Measurement of pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature. Measured after participant has been sitting for at least 5 minutes.

data.name: Weight Measurement
data.label: Body Weight
data.description: Measurement of participant body weight per standardized protocol (Appendix 9)

data.name: Height Measurement
data.label: Height
data.description: Measurement of participant height per standardized protocol (Appendix 9), collected at screening

data.name: Waist Circumference Measurement
data.label: Waist Circumference
data.description: Measurement of waist circumference per standardized protocol (Appendix 9)

data.name: Intravenous Infusion of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Intravenous infusion, for therapy, prophylaxis, or diagnosis; initial, up to 1 hour

data.label: IV Infusion
data.description: Intravenous infusion of mirikizumab 300 mg at Weeks 0, 4, and 8 during induction. Maximum rate of 10 mg/min by IV infusion over no less than 30 minutes. Administered only by authorized study personnel.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection _ Mirikizumab
data.description: Subcutaneous injection of mirikizumab 200 mg Q4W (as 2 consecutive injections of 100 mg each) starting at Week 12 during maintenance. Administered onsite or offsite by participant/caregiver after training.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Tirzepatide

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection _ Tirzepatide
data.description: Subcutaneous injection of tirzepatide administered weekly (QW) with dose escalation from 2.5 mg up to 15 mg. Initial administration onsite; subsequent doses may be self_administered at home by participant or caregiver after training.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Placebo

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection _ Placebo
data.description: Subcutaneous injection of placebo to match tirzepatide, administered weekly (QW). Initial administration onsite; subsequent doses may be self_administered at home.

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Test
data.label: Fecal Calprotectin
data.description: Stool sample collection for fecal calprotectin measurement as a biomarker of intestinal inflammation

data.name: Stool Culture

code.decode: Culture, bacterial; stool, aerobic, with isolation and presumptive identification of isolates

data.label: Stool Culture
data.description: Stool sample collection for culture testing. Additional local stool testing (e.g., ova and parasites) allowed at investigator discretion.

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: Pregnancy Test
data.description: Pregnancy testing as part of safety assessments per Section 8.2.6

data.name: Tuberculosis Skin Test / QuantiFERON_TB Gold / T_SPOT.TB

code.decode: Tuberculosis test, cell mediated immunity antigen response measurement

data.label: TB Testing
data.description: Assessment for tuberculosis using skin test, QuantiFERON_TB Gold test, or T_SPOT.TB. Positive result triggers chest x_ray.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Sample Collection _ Blood

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Exploratory Blood Biomarkers
data.description: Collection of blood samples for exploratory biomarker analysis and storage

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Sample Collection _ Stool Supernatant

code.decode: Sputum obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Exploratory Stool Biomarkers
data.description: Collection of stool supernatant samples for exploratory biomarker analysis and storage

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Sample Collection _ Colon/Rectum Tissue

code.decode: Colonoscopy, flexible; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Colonic/Rectal Tissue Biomarkers
data.description: Collection of colonic and rectal tissue biopsies during colonoscopy/sigmoidoscopy for exploratory biomarker analysis and storage

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collection for genetic analysis. Sample can be obtained at or after Visit 2.

data.name: C_Reactive Protein (CRP) Measurement
data.label: CRP
data.description: Blood sample collection for CRP measurement as an inflammatory biomarker at various time points (Weeks 4, 12, 24, and 52)

data.name: Suicidal Ideation and Behavior Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Administration of patient_focused health risk assessment instrument

data.label: C_SSRS Assessment
data.description: Clinician_administered Columbia_Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C_SSRS) assessment. Screening/Baseline version at Visit 1; Since Last Assessed version at subsequent visits.

data.name: Depression Monitoring
data.label: QIDS_SR16
data.description: Quick Inventory for Depressive Symptomatology – Self_Report 16 items (QIDS_SR16) administered electronically at screening, Week 12, and Week 24

data.name: Extraintestinal Manifestations Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: EIM Assessment
data.description: Assessment of extraintestinal manifestations of ulcerative colitis at screening and Week 24/52 per Section 8.2.1

data.name: Modified Mayo Score Review

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: mMS
data.description: Clinician_administered electronic review of modified Mayo Score (mMS) for assessment of ulcerative colitis disease activity per Section 8.1.1.1

data.name: Clinical Safety Laboratory Tests
data.label: Clinical Labs
data.description: Clinical safety laboratory tests including hematology, chemistry, urinalysis, and other panels per Appendix 2. Includes nutritional monitoring panel and hypersensitivity event labs.

data.name: Lifestyle Counseling

code.decode: Preventive medicine counseling and/or risk factor reduction intervention

data.label: Diet, Exercise, and Lifestyle Counseling
data.description: Structured counseling on diet, exercise, and lifestyle goals per Sections 5.3.1 and 5.3.2, conducted at each visit during induction and maintenance periods

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS
data.description: Prefilled syringe for subcutaneous injection of mirikizumab 100 mg during maintenance phase (2 consecutive injections of 100 mg each to deliver 200 mg Q4W). Also used for tirzepatide and placebo subcutaneous administration.

data.name: Intravenous Infusion System
data.label: IV Infusion Line
data.description: Intravenous infusion system used for administration of mirikizumab 300 mg during induction at a maximum rate of 10 mg/min over no less than 30 minutes

data.name: 12_Lead ECG Device
data.label: ECG Machine
data.description: Local 12_lead electrocardiogram device used for cardiac safety monitoring at screening and as needed throughout the study

data.name: DXA Scanner
data.label: Dual_Energy X_Ray Absorptiometry Scanner
data.description: Whole body DXA scanner used for exploratory body composition assessment

data.name: Electronic Diary (eDiary)
data.label: eDiary
data.description: Electronic diary used by participants to record daily symptom data including bowel movement urgency (Urgency NRS) and other patient_reported outcomes required for mMS assessment and colonoscopy scheduling

data.name: Interactive Web_Response System (IWRS)
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web_response system used for study intervention dispensing, visit registration, and randomization

data.name: Colonoscope
data.label: Flexible Colonoscope
data.description: Flexible colonoscope used for colonoscopy with biopsy for assessment of ulcerative colitis disease activity and tissue sample collection

data.name: Sigmoidoscope
data.label: Flexible Sigmoidoscope
data.description: Flexible sigmoidoscope used as an alternative to colonoscopy for assessment of ulcerative colitis disease activity and tissue sample collection

data.name: Stored Exploratory Biomarker Samples _ Blood
data.description: Blood samples collected for exploratory biomarker analysis are stored for future use. Retention details are described in Section 10.1.12 (Sample Retention).

data.name: Stored Exploratory Biomarker Samples _ Stool Supernatant
data.description: Stool supernatant samples collected for exploratory biomarker analysis are stored for future use. Retention details are described in Section 10.1.12 (Sample Retention).

data.name: Stored Exploratory Biomarker Samples _ Colon/Rectum Tissue
data.description: Colonic and rectal tissue biopsies obtained during endoscopy are stored for exploratory biomarker analysis. Retention details are described in Section 10.1.12 (Sample Retention).

data.name: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collected for genetic analysis per Appendix 13 (Genetics). Sample can be obtained at or after Visit 2. Retention and DNA testing details are described in Appendix 13 and Section 10.1.12.

data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To evaluate if concomitant administration of mirikizumab and tirzepatide at the MTD (up to 15 mg) is superior to mirikizumab and placebo in simultaneously achieving clinical remission and weight reduction

data.name: Key Secondary Gastroenterologic Outcomes Objective
data.text: To evaluate the effect of treatment with concomitant administration of mirikizumab and tirzepatide at the MTD (up to 15 mg) versus mirikizumab and placebo as measured by gastroenterologic outcomes

data.name: Additional Secondary Gastroenterologic and Patient_Reported Outcomes Objective
data.text: To evaluate the effect of treatment with concomitant administration of mirikizumab and tirzepatide at the MTD (up to 15 mg) versus mirikizumab and placebo as measured by gastroenterologic and patient_reported outcomes

data.text: Obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m2) OR overweight (BMI ≥27 to <30 kg/m2) with at least 1 weight_related comorbid condition: hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, or cardiovascular disease

data.text: Tirzepatide is dose_escalated during Study Period II (first 24 weeks) toward the maximum tolerated dose (up to 15 mg) per Section 6.1.4

data.name: Dose Modification for Mirikizumab or Tirzepatide
data.text: Dose modification rules for mirikizumab (Section 6.6.1) and tirzepatide (Section 6.6.2) are applied based on tolerability and adverse events

data.name: Temporary Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Study intervention may be temporarily discontinued (interrupted) per Section 7.1.2, including for hepatic criteria per Section 7.1.3

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including discontinuation due to adverse events and meeting hepatic discontinuation criteria (Section 7.1.3). Participants with early permanent discontinuation are counted as nonresponders for the primary estimand.

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Disease Progression
data.text: Rescue therapy may be initiated in the setting of disease progression per Section 6.9.6; corticosteroid use and taper rules are specified in Section 6.9.5

data.name: Screen Failure and Rescreening for COVID_19
data.text: Participants who do not meet COVID_19 eligibility criteria must be screen failed and may only rescreen after at least 14 days have passed since recovery (symptomatic) or since first positive molecular test (asymptomatic)

data.name: Prohibited Medication Use
data.text: Use of specified prohibited medication is an intercurrent event addressed by the composite strategy; participants are considered nonresponders after the first occurrence. Prohibited concomitant medications are listed in Section 6.9.3.

data.name: Screen Failure
data.description: Participants not meeting eligibility criteria during the up to 5_week (≤35 day) screening period are screen failures; rescreening permitted for COVID_19 after ≥14 days when criteria are met

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from Study
data.description: Participant discontinuation or withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2, which may occur at any time for any reason

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention due to Adverse Events
data.description: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention due to adverse events, serious adverse events, injection site reactions, or hepatic safety criteria (Sections 7.1.1 and 7.1.3)

data.name: Lost to Follow_Up
data.description: Participant is lost to follow_up per Section 7.3

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of up to 52 weeks of treatment (24_week induction/dose escalation plus 28_week maintenance) and the 4_week safety follow_up, for a maximum total duration of approximately 61 weeks

data.name: Continued Access After End of Study
data.description: Continued access to study intervention after the end of the study may be provided per Section 6.7

data.name: Eligibility/Randomization Decision at Visit 2
data.description: At Visit 2, eligibility is confirmed (including centrally reviewed mMS 5_9 and Endoscopic Subscore 2_3 within 21 days before Visit 2 and required washout periods) and participants are randomized 1:1

data.name: Tirzepatide MTD Determination Decision
data.description: During the 24_week induction and dose escalation period, dose escalation continues until the maximum tolerated dose (up to 15 mg) is reached

data.name: Week 24 Metabolic and Clinical Assessment Decision
data.description: Week 24 assessment of percent change in body weight, BMI, waist circumference, HbA1c, and glucose at the transition from induction/dose escalation to maintenance

data.name: Week 52 Primary Endpoint Decision
data.description: Primary endpoint evaluation of simultaneous clinical remission and ≥10% weight reduction at Week 52 without early permanent discontinuation or prohibited medication use

data.name: Safety Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Ongoing decision point for temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation of study intervention based on hepatic and other safety criteria

data.name: Rescue Therapy Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate rescue therapy and/or corticosteroid taper in the event of disease progression
